question: How many times does an average urban Indian household order groceries online per month?
idealClarificationQuestions: Online grocery includes BigBasket + Amazon Fresh + Blinkit + Zepto + Instamart? Yes — all aggregators combined.
Per household or per individual? Per household.
Urban metro / Tier-1 only or all urban (Tier 1+2)? Urban Tier 1+2.
Average user (any user who ordered) or average across all households (including non-users)? Average across active grocery-app households.
